Red Bull Racing: Based in Milton Keynes. Took over Jaguar Racing in 2005. Won both titles in 2010 and 2011 with cars by Adrian Newey.
Ferrari: Racing in the championship since 1950, the only team in every season. Based in Maranello. Builds its own engines.
Lotus: Based in Enstone. Raced as Toleman, Benetton and Renault before. Renamed Lotus F1 Team in 2012. Uses Renault engines.
McLaren: Founded by Bruce McLaren in 1963. Based in Woking. Has won eight constructors' titles. Uses Mercedes engines.
Mercedes: Based in Brackley. Raced as BAR, Honda and Brawn, the 2009 champions. The Mercedes works team since 2010.
Sauber: Founded by Peter Sauber. Based in Hinwil, Switzerland. In the championship since 1993. Uses Ferrari engines.
Force India: Based in Silverstone, at the old Jordan factory. Owned by Vijay Mallya and Sahara. Uses Mercedes engines.
Williams: Founded by Frank Williams and Patrick Head. Based in Grove. Has won nine constructors' titles. Back to Renault engines in 2012.
Toro Rosso: Based in Faenza. Red Bull's second team since 2006, formerly Minardi. Sebastian Vettel won here in 2008. Uses Ferrari engines.
Marussia: Entered in 2010 as Virgin Racing. Based in Banbury. Russian owned. First car with a wind tunnel in 2012.
HRT: Entered in 2010 as Hispania Racing. Moved to Madrid in 2012. Spanish owned since 2011.
Caterham: Founded by Tony Fernandes as Lotus Racing in 2010. Raced as Team Lotus in 2011, Caterham from 2012. Based in Leafield.
